title: Critical-path reduction: shrink Console Insights surface for MVP (dashboards, tracing, cost breakdown)
creator: Asha Patel
description: Objective: Reduce the surface area for Console Insights to hit an MVP launch window while preserving the highest-value telemetry for engineering and product customers. Scope includes dashboards, tracing, and cost breakdown tiles. This ticket captures the cut decisions, acceptance criteria, rollout constraints, and follow-ups for restoration after MVP.
background: Multiple stakeholder reviews indicated the original Insights spec was too broad for the next release. Engineers flagged risk around trace ingestion cost and the data pipeline work required for per-token cost breakdown. PM/Design prioritized features by usage and decision value: route-level latency + error rates, model-level cost rollups, and a lightweight trace sampling view provide most customer value. Everything else should be deferred.
proposed_cuts: Remove per-token / per-request cost breakdown chart from MVP (defer to post-MVP). Replace with model-level aggregate cost per 1k tokens.
Defer full flamegraph trace explorer; ship a sampled span list with basic duration sorting instead.
Remove timeline scrubber and full session replay; keep static snapshot charts (p50/p95 latency over time) with 1-hour, 24-hour, 7-day ranges.
Limit dashboard cards to top 6 tiles: Route Summary, Errors by Type, Latency Distribution (p50/p95), Model Cost Rollup, Active Routes, Recent Failed Requests.
Remove anomaly detection / alert suggestions from MVP; provide manual query link to metrics instead.
Delay advanced trace correlation (trace-to-cost join) requiring data pipeline joins until after MVP.
Disable high-cardinality tag dimensions in dashboards; support only route, model, and region dimensions.
Cap trace sampling to 5% for initial telemetry ingestion to contain cost and storage needs.
kept_features: Route-level p50/p95 latency time series with configurable windowing.
Top-5 error types and example request IDs for immediate debugging.
Model-level cost rollup (USD / 1k tokens) with trendline and top-3 cost drivers.
Basic sampled span list for recent traces with span durations, service, and a link to full trace (if requested).
Simple role-based access visibility for console users (no advanced RBAC controls in MVP).
acceptance_criteria: Dashboard deploy includes exactly the six tiles listed in kept_features and no additional tiles beyond approved small-card set.
Latency charts show correct p50 and p95 calculations and match backend metrics for supplied test dataset (QA dataset v1).
Model-level cost rollup displays USD totals and per-1k token rate; numbers reconcile with billing mock in GH PR #1428 within 2% margin.
Trace sampling enforced at 5% at ingestion layer and verified by sampling test harness (logs in S3: circleci/samples/PM-20578).
All deferred features have tracking subtasks created (PM follow-ups) and product docs updated indicating rationale for cuts.
Console performance: initial dashboard load (cold) <= 900ms on staging with 20 concurrent users and synthetic dataset representing 1M requests/day distribution.
tradeoffs_and_risks: Cutting per-token cost and advanced trace explorer reduces initial debugging fidelity; risk that customers needing deep trace-to-cost correlation will be dissatisfied. We mitigate by shipping clear workarounds: exported CSV for top errors and a ‘request example’ link to replay a single request in devtools. There is also operational risk if sampling or aggregation is misconfigured; ops and infra must sign off on sampling gating.
decision_rationale: Prioritize quick time-to-value for most customers: high-level latency, error visibility, and cost trends deliver immediate operational insight and reduce regressions. Full fidelity features are costly in storage/compute and delay launch.
rollout_plan: Phase 1 (staging): Feature-flagged deploy to internal beta tenants. Validate acceptance criteria and reconcile cost numbers with billing mock.
Phase 2 (limited production): Enable for 10 pilot customers on Dedicated and Hosted tiers with telemetry monitoring for ingestion cost spike; maintain kill-switch flag.
Phase 3 (general availability): Lift flag after 2-week pilot with no critical regressions and infra sign-off. Post-MVP backlog items scheduled for next quarter.
open_questions: Should we offer a one-click export of raw trace spans for customers who need full fidelity before advanced explorer ships?
What SLA commitments apply to sampled traces vs full traces? Need legal/ops input.
Can billing team produce a synthetic cost dataset for QA that matches production distribution?
Do Security/GDPR requirements change with trace sampling retention policy?
